_about: The services of this setup: their ports, how to see that they answer, and where they run in each mode.
lib/endpoints.py turns this and local.env (LOCALLLM_MODE, LOCALLLM_APPS, HELPER_HOST, MAIN_HOST, PLACE_<NAME>) into
~/.config/localllm/endpoints.json (and endpoints.env for the scripts), the one place clients read addresses from.
single: the service runs on the main PC in single mode (false: only on the helper PC, in split mode).
split: where it runs in split mode (main or helper); movable: PLACE_<NAME>=main|helper in local.env may change it.
owui_only: true for Open WebUI and services only it uses (off everywhere when LOCALLLM_APPS has no owui).
together: services that always run on the same PC (the search gateway reads Open WebUI's database).
split_url: the address clients use in split mode, when it isn't http://<host>:<port> ({helper} = HELPER_HOST).
Speech-to-text: on the helper its own service (whisper); in single mode Whisper runs inside Open WebUI. The
document search models always run inside Open WebUI, on whichever PC it runs.

services.name: small-model
